title.zh: 整数分解：N = MC + q（定义）
title.en: Integer decomposition N = MC + q (definition)

meaning.zh: 对已对齐、逻辑一致的计数状态，原周期编号 $N$ 唯一分解为高位组计数 $C$ 与组内 residue $q$。
meaning.en: For an aligned, logically coherent count state, the raw-cycle index $N$ splits uniquely into the high group count $C$ and the in-group residue $q$.

vars.zh: 原周期整数编号（单位：原周期）
分组倍率，本报告主要取 4 或 8
高位组计数；一个计数 = M 个 $CK_0$ 周期
vars.en: high group count; one count = M $CK_0$ cycles

vars.zh: 组内原周期 residue，$0,\ldots,M-1$；不是 TDC 小数码
vars.en: in-group raw-cycle residue, $0,\ldots,M-1$; not a TDC fraction

assumptions.zh: 只对“已对齐的、逻辑一致的状态”成立：$C$ 与 $q$ 属于同一逻辑 epoch，且已完成原点/延迟对齐。
assumptions.en: Holds only for aligned, logically coherent states: $C$ and $q$ belong to the same logical epoch and are origin/delay aligned.

derivation.zh: 带余除法：对任意整数 $N$ 与正整数 $M$，存在唯一的一对 $(C,q)$ 使 $N=MC+q$ 且 $0\le q\le M-1$。
derivation.en: Division with remainder: for any integer $N$ and positive $M$ there is a unique pair $(C,q)$ with $N=MC+q$ and $0\le q\le M-1$.
derivation.tex: N=M\left\lfloor N/M\right\rfloor+(N\bmod M),\qquad 0\le N\bmod M\le M-1

derivation.zh: 因此 $C=\operatorname{floor}(N/M)$、$q=N\bmod M$ 是由 $N$ 唯一决定的定义——不是从电路推出的结论。
derivation.en: Hence $C=\operatorname{floor}(N/M)$ and $q=N\bmod M$ are definitions uniquely fixed by $N$ — not something derived from a circuit.

derivation.zh: 坐标含义：一个 $C$ 计数代表 $M$ 个 $CK_0$ 周期；$q$ 在 $0\ldots M-1$ 循环，记录组内第几个原周期。
derivation.en: Coordinate meaning: one count of $C$ stands for $M$ cycles of $CK_0$; $q$ cycles through $0\ldots M-1$, recording the raw cycle within the group.

derivation.zh: 为什么这不是 CDC 正确性的证明：式 (1) 只描述“正确状态”；独立采样 $C$ 和 $q$ 后再拼接是否正确，是电路的同步、延迟匹配、编码和边界校正问题（见式 (10) 与 §6.1）。L01 的 8192 个案例只验证了算术，并且假设 $C$ 与 $q$ 相干。
derivation.en: Why this is not a proof of CDC correctness: Eq. (1) only describes correct states; whether independently sampled $C$ and $q$ can be concatenated correctly is a matter of synchronisation, delay matching, encoding and boundary correction (see Eq. (10) and §6.1). The 8192 cases of L01 only check arithmetic and assume coherent $C$ and $q$.

pitfalls.zh: 不能由式 (1) 推出“任意时刻独立采样 $C$ 和 $q$ 后拼接都正确”；$q$ 不是 TDC 小数码；改变 $CK_0$ 后 CNT 权重、FCW、fine 归一化与 edge ID 必须一起换算。
pitfalls.en: Eq. (1) does not imply that $C$ and $q$ sampled independently at any time concatenate correctly; $q$ is not a TDC fraction; changing $CK_0$ requires rescaling CNT weights, FCW, fine normalisation and edge IDs together.

title.en: Legal carry (C, M−1) → (C+1, 0)

meaning.zh: 合法连续计数中，低位从 $M-1$ 回到 0 的同一拍，高位恰好加 1；这是计数谱系（count lineage）的必要条件。
meaning.en: In a legal continuous count, the high count increments exactly on the step where the low residue wraps from $M-1$ to 0 — a necessary condition of the count lineage.

vars.zh: 高位组计数
低位 residue 的最大值
vars.en: largest value of the low residue

assumptions.zh: 计数器每个 $CK_0$ 上升沿 $N\to N+1$；状态按式 (1) 已对齐。
assumptions.en: The counter steps $N\to N+1$ on every $CK_0$ rising edge; states are aligned per Eq. (1).

derivation.zh: 由式 (1)，$N$ 与 $N+1$ 各自有唯一分解。若 $q<M-1$，则 $N+1=MC+(q+1)$，高位不变。
derivation.en: By Eq. (1), $N$ and $N+1$ each decompose uniquely. If $q<M-1$, then $N+1=MC+(q+1)$ and the high count is unchanged.
If $q=M-1$:

derivation.zh: 因此高位必须恰好在低位 wrap 的那一拍进位：慢计数不能只是任意同频 /M 时钟驱动，必须与低位 wrap 在逻辑上同源（ETRI 的 11→00 与 CKVD4 即为一例）。
derivation.en: So the high count must carry exactly on the low wrap: the slow count cannot be driven by just any /M clock of the same rate; it must be logically derived from the low-bit wrap (ETRI's 11→00 with CKVD4 is an instance).

derivation.zh: 实现检查：普通二进制 $q[2]$ 的上升沿对应低三位 3→4，下降沿才对应 7→0；把 $q$ 的最高位当 /8 时钟时，必须核对高位触发极性、复位原点与流水延迟。
derivation.en: Implementation check: for plain binary, the rising edge of $q[2]$ marks 3→4 and only its falling edge marks 7→0; when the MSB of $q$ is used as the /8 clock, check the high-bit trigger polarity, reset origin and pipeline delay.

pitfalls.zh: 不能只看信号名 CKVD8 就默认其某个有效沿等于式 (2) 的 carry；连续计数成立也不等于参考相关 snapshot 已经安全。
pitfalls.en: Never assume from the name CKVD8 that one of its active edges equals the carry of Eq. (2); a continuous count also does not make the reference-related snapshot safe.

title.zh: 被选物理边沿的锚点坐标 A = J + α
title.en: Anchor coordinate of the selected edge A = J + α

meaning.zh: 在连续展开的原时钟相位 $\Phi_0$ 上，第 $k$ 次事件实际被选的物理边沿坐标等于其原始上升沿的绝对编号 $J_k$ 加周期内偏移 $\alpha_k$。
meaning.en: On the unwrapped raw-clock phase $\Phi_0$, the coordinate of the physical edge actually selected at event $k$ equals the absolute index $J_k$ of its raw rising edge plus the intra-cycle offset $\alpha_k$.

vars.zh: 第 k 次事件被选边沿的坐标（原周期）
vars.en: coordinate of the selected edge at event k (raw cycles)

vars.zh: 实际原始上升沿的绝对编号
vars.en: absolute index of the actual raw rising edge

vars.zh: 选中边沿相对该上升沿的周期内偏移；仅在独立存在该自由度时加入
vars.en: intra-cycle offset of the selected edge from that rising edge; only when that freedom exists

assumptions.zh: 相位以 $\Phi_0(t)$（原周期）为坐标，并约定第 $J$ 个原始上升沿处 $\Phi_0=J$；只选上升沿时 $\alpha=0$。
assumptions.en: Phase is measured on $\Phi_0(t)$ in raw cycles, with the convention $\Phi_0=J$ at raw rising edge $J$; $\alpha=0$ when only rising edges are selected.

derivation.zh: 以连续展开的原时钟相位 $\Phi_0(t)$ 为定义：原始上升沿位于整数相位处，第 $J$ 条上升沿对应 $\Phi_0=J$。
derivation.en: Use the unwrapped raw-clock phase $\Phi_0(t)$ as the definition: raw rising edges sit at integer phases, rising edge $J$ at $\Phi_0=J$.

derivation.zh: 被选边沿可能不是上升沿本身（下降沿、多相中的某一相），它与第 $J$ 条上升沿相差周期内偏移 $\alpha$（原周期）。
derivation.en: The selected edge may not be the rising edge itself (a falling edge, one tap of a multiphase set); it lies an intra-cycle offset $\alpha$ (raw cycles) after rising edge $J$.

derivation.zh: 于是该物理边沿的坐标为整数部分与偏移之和：
derivation.en: So the coordinate of that physical edge is the sum of the integer part and the offset:

pitfalls.zh: $J$ 必须是真实执行的边沿编号（$J_{\mathrm{observed}}$），不能用计划值自证；$\alpha$ 必须以原周期为单位，不能混入分频后周期。
pitfalls.en: $J$ must be the index of the edge actually executed ($J_{\mathrm{observed}}$), not self-certified by the plan; $\alpha$ must be in raw cycles, not divided-clock periods.

title.zh: 参考到被选边沿的精确相位间隔 μ
title.en: Exact reference-to-edge phase interval μ

meaning.zh: 从参考事件 $t_{R,k}$ 到被选边沿 $t_{E,k}$，原时钟实际走过的相位（原周期）等于瞬时频率的积分；其符号由积分上下限决定。
meaning.en: The phase the raw clock actually traverses from the reference event $t_{R,k}$ to the selected edge $t_{E,k}$ (in raw cycles) is the integral of the instantaneous frequency; its sign follows the integration limits.

vars.zh: 有符号相位间隔（原周期）
参考事件时刻与被选边沿时刻
$CK_0$ 瞬时频率

assumptions.zh: 精确定义，不需要频率恒定；只需 $\Phi_0$ 连续展开。
assumptions.en: Exact definition; no constant-frequency assumption, only an unwrapped $\Phi_0$.

derivation.zh: 以原周期计的相位，其时间导数就是瞬时频率：
derivation.en: Phase measured in raw cycles has the instantaneous frequency as its time derivative:

derivation.en: Integrate over $[t_{R,k},t_{E,k}]$:

derivation.zh: 选 following edge 时 $t_E>t_R$，$\mu>0$；选 preceding edge 时积分上下限颠倒，$\mu<0$。同一公式覆盖两种情形，不再需要未定义的“±TDC”约定。
derivation.en: For a following edge $t_E>t_R$ and $\mu>0$; for a preceding edge the limits swap and $\mu<0$. One formula covers both cases — no undefined "±TDC" convention is needed.

pitfalls.zh: $\mu$ 的单位是原周期，不是秒；把时间差换成相位需要式 (6) 的近似或更精确的积分。
pitfalls.en: $\mu$ is in raw cycles, not seconds; turning a time difference into phase needs the approximation of Eq. (6) or a more exact integral.

title.zh: 锚点减残差：Φ0(t_R) = A − μ
title.en: Anchor minus residual: Φ0(t_R) = A − μ

meaning.zh: 参考时刻的完整相位 = 被选边沿的锚点坐标 − 参考到该边沿的相位间隔。整数信息只来自锚点，fine 只提供残差。
meaning.en: Full phase at the reference instant = anchor coordinate of the selected edge − phase interval from the reference to that edge. Integer information comes only from the anchor; fine only supplies the residual.

vars.zh: 参考时刻的原时钟相位（原周期）
vars.en: raw-clock phase at the reference instant (raw cycles)

assumptions.en: $A_k$ and $\mu_k$ must refer to the same physical edge (common anchor, invariant I2).

derivation.en: From Eq. (3): $\Phi_0(t_{E,k})=A_k$.
From Eq. (4): $\Phi_0(t_{E,k})-\Phi_0(t_{R,k})=\mu_k$.

derivation.zh: 它取代被撤回的通用写法 $8C+q+e/8+\epsilon$：后者可能让 $q$ 与多相码重复表示同一区间，并混用分频后周期与原周期。
derivation.en: It replaces the withdrawn generic form $8C+q+e/8+\epsilon$, in which $q$ and the multiphase code may encode the same interval twice and divided-clock and raw-cycle units get mixed.

pitfalls.zh: coarse 与 fine 必须针对同一锚点；整数取 $J+1$ 而 fine 仍相对 $J$ 会产生一整周期错误（式 12）。
pitfalls.en: Coarse and fine must refer to one anchor; taking $J+1$ for the integer while fine still refers to $J$ yields a whole-cycle error (Eq. 12).

title.zh: 固定周期归一化（局部近似）
title.en: Fixed-period normalisation (local approximation)

meaning.zh: 当局部间隔内频率近似恒定时，可用测得的时间差除以周期估计得到相位间隔的估计。
meaning.en: When the frequency is roughly constant over the local interval, the phase interval can be estimated as the measured time difference divided by a period estimate.

vars.zh: 相位间隔估计（原周期）
测得的参考到边沿时间差（s）
第 k 次事件附近的原周期估计（s）

assumptions.en: Only valid when the frequency is roughly constant over the local interval; for fast modulation, strong transients or multi-cycle spans, evaluate the error against Eq. (4).

derivation.en: Substituting the measured $\widehat{\Delta t}_k$ and the period estimate $\widehat T_0[k]$ gives Eq. (6).

derivation.zh: 误差上界：若间隔内频率估计误差有界为 $\delta f_{max}$，则
derivation.en: Error bound: if the frequency-estimate error over the interval is bounded by $\delta f_{max}$, then

derivation.zh: 上界随 $|\Delta t|$ 线性增长——这正是过长的 selected-edge 间隔不宜仅靠固定周期归一化的原因。
derivation.en: The bound grows linearly with $|\Delta t|$ — which is why an overly long selected-edge interval should not rely on fixed-period normalisation alone.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把式 (6) 当作式 (4) 的精确替代；归一化用的周期估计必须与 TDC 校准版本相容。
pitfalls.en: Eq. (6) is not an exact replacement for Eq. (4); the period estimate used for normalisation must match the TDC calibration version.

title.zh: 分频相位换算到原周期：Φ0 = 4Φd
title.en: Divided-clock phase to raw cycles: Φ0 = 4Φd

meaning.zh: 理想 /4 八相示例中，分频后周期内的区域码 $a$ 换算到原周期是 $a/2$，而不是 $a/8$。
meaning.en: In the ideal /4 eight-phase example, the region code $a$ inside a divided period converts to $a/2$ raw cycles, not $a/8$.

分频后周期计数
八相区域标签 $0\ldots7$
分频后周期单位下的剩余小数
原时钟相位（原周期）

assumptions.zh: 理想 /4、八相均匀分布且相位原点对齐。真实电路还要处理相位排列、边沿极性、DCC 和原点偏置。
assumptions.en: Ideal /4, uniformly spaced eight phases, aligned phase origins. Real circuits must also handle phase ordering, edge polarity, DCC and origin offsets.

derivation.zh: 在分频后周期内用八相区域表示相位（单位：分频后周期）：
derivation.en: Express the phase with the eight-phase region inside a divided period (unit: divided period):

derivation.zh: 一个分频后周期 = 4 个原周期，故换到原周期要乘 4：$\Phi_0=4\Phi_d$。
derivation.en: One divided period = 4 raw cycles, so converting to raw cycles multiplies by 4: $\Phi_0=4\Phi_d$.

derivation.en: So the eight-phase spacing is $1/2$ raw cycle ($T_0/2$), not $T_0/8$ — exactly the unit correction for Kuo 2018.

title.zh: 区域码拆分：a 已包含 q
title.en: Splitting the region code: a already contains q

meaning.zh: 把区域码 $a$ 拆成整原周期 $q$ 与半周期位 $p$，可见 $a$ 已经包含 $q$ 的信息；再相加 $q+a/8$ 就是混合单位并重复计数。
meaning.en: Splitting the region code $a$ into whole raw cycles $q$ and a half-cycle bit $p$ shows that $a$ already contains $q$; adding $q+a/8$ mixes units and double-counts.

vars.en: whole raw cycles encoded by the region ($0\ldots3$)

原周期单位下的剩余小数

assumptions.en: Same as Eq. (7): ideal /4, uniform eight phases, aligned origins. A dimensional derivation, not a code-by-code copy of any source decoder truth table.

derivation.zh: 令 $q=\operatorname{floor}(a/2)$、$p=a\bmod 2$，则 $a=2q+p$。
derivation.en: Let $q=\operatorname{floor}(a/2)$ and $p=a\bmod 2$, so $a=2q+p$.
Then $a/2=q+p/2$; substitute into Eq. (7):

derivation.zh: 记 $\epsilon_0=4\epsilon_d$ 即得式 (8)。
derivation.en: Writing $\epsilon_0=4\epsilon_d$ gives Eq. (8).

derivation.zh: 结论：$q$ 已从 $a$ 中出现一次；若再写 $q+a/8$，同一相位区间被计数两次且单位混合。这就是不能通用地写 $8C+q+e/8+\epsilon$ 的原因。
derivation.en: Conclusion: $q$ already appears from $a$; writing $q+a/8$ counts the same interval twice and mixes units. That is why $8C+q+e/8+\epsilon$ cannot be used generically.

pitfalls.zh: 真实电路的相位排列、边沿极性、DCC 与原点偏置都会改变映射；不要把这里的 $q$ 与 /8 split counter 的 3-bit residue 混为一谈。
pitfalls.en: Real phase ordering, edge polarity, DCC and origin offsets change the mapping; do not confuse this $q$ with the 3-bit residue of a /8 split counter.

title.zh: Sony 的两个 XOR：CRRCT 与 SIGN
title.en: Sony's two XORs: CRRCT and SIGN

meaning.zh: 比较经参考重定时采样的整数路径 VINT 与直接采样的 VFRAC：最低位不一致则需修正（CRRCT=1），SIGN 决定 −1 还是 +1。
meaning.en: Compare the integer path VINT (sampled after reference retiming) with the directly sampled VFRAC: if their LSBs differ a correction is needed (CRRCT=1), and SIGN picks −1 or +1.

vars.zh: CNTO[0] 与慢 accumulator 高位形成、经参考重定时后采样的整数码
vars.en: integer code formed by CNTO[0] and the slow accumulator high bits, sampled after reference retiming

vars.zh: REFCLK 直接采样的 CNTO[3:0]，带周期冗余的状态码
vars.en: CNTO[3:0] sampled directly by REFCLK; a state code with cycle redundancy

vars.zh: 是否需要修正
修正方向

assumptions.zh: 原实施例用多相 latch/correction 替代传统 TDC；修正量“1”按原相位单位解释。个别 retiming 节点/位序需结合原文 Fig.6、8、11、12 交叉确认。
assumptions.en: The embodiment replaces a conventional TDC with multiphase latch/correction; the "1" of the correction is in its original phase unit. Some retiming nodes/bit orders must be cross-checked with Fig. 6, 8, 11, 12 of the original.

derivation.zh: 同一个 CNTO 走两条路径：CNTO[0] 与慢 accumulator 高位组成整数码，经参考重定时后采样为 VINT；CNTO[3:0] 由 REFCLK 直接采为 VFRAC。
derivation.en: One CNTO feeds two paths: CNTO[0] with the slow accumulator high bits forms the integer code, sampled after reference retiming as VINT; CNTO[3:0] is sampled directly by REFCLK as VFRAC.

derivation.zh: 若两条路径看到同一状态，则 VINT[0] = VFRAC[0]，CRRCT = 0，修正为 0。
derivation.en: If both paths see the same state, VINT[0] = VFRAC[0], CRRCT = 0 and the correction is 0.

derivation.zh: 若两条路径的状态差异使最低位不一致，CRRCT = 1；SIGN = VFRAC[0] ⊕ VFRAC[3] 区分方向：SIGN = 0 → −1，SIGN = 1 → +1（原实施例送往 phase comparator 的修正）。
derivation.en: If the state difference between the paths makes the LSBs disagree, CRRCT = 1; SIGN = VFRAC[0] ⊕ VFRAC[3] gives the direction: SIGN = 0 → −1, SIGN = 1 → +1 (the correction sent to the phase comparator in the embodiment).

derivation.zh: 本书立场：这是原文披露的修正规则（A-P），不是对任意异步错误都保证唯一复原的证明；VFRAC 的值跨至 1.75，并非普通纯小数二进制。
derivation.en: The book's position: this is the correction rule disclosed in the source (A-P), not a proof of unique recovery from arbitrary asynchronous errors; VFRAC values reach 1.75 and are not a plain binary fraction.

head.zh: 原实施例送往 phase comparator 的修正
head.en: Correction sent to the phase comparator (embodiment)

pitfalls.zh: 不能从式 (9) 推出对任意异步错误都保证唯一复原；直接把这种 low-bit XOR 搬到 /8 模型未必能检测高位错组（式 11 的低位盲区）；不能说它已接上本项目 short TDC。
pitfalls.en: Eq. (9) does not guarantee unique recovery from any asynchronous error; transplanting such a low-bit XOR into the /8 model may miss high-bit group errors (the low-bit blind spot of Eq. 11); it is not connected to this project's short TDC.

title.zh: 分单位的修正接口 N_corr
title.en: Unit-separated correction interface N_corr

meaning.zh: 把组级修正 $\kappa_C$（单位：一组）与原周期修正 $\kappa_N$（单位：一个原周期）分开，再与重构后的 residue $q_{\mathrm{corr}}$ 组合成修正后的原周期编号。
meaning.en: Keep the group-level correction $\kappa_C$ (unit: one group) separate from the raw-cycle correction $\kappa_N$ (unit: one raw cycle), then combine them with the reconstructed residue $q_{\mathrm{corr}}$ into the corrected raw-cycle index.

vars.zh: 捕获到的高位组计数
经合法码/状态重构后的 residue
组单位修正
原周期单位修正

assumptions.zh: $\kappa_C\in\{-1,0,+1\}$ 只有在采样延迟及同步延迟已证明最多跨一组时才合理；否则必须扩展修正集合或判为无效。
assumptions.en: $\kappa_C\in\{-1,0,+1\}$ is justified only if sampling and synchroniser delay are proven to span at most one group; otherwise the set must grow or the observation be declared invalid.

derivation.zh: 捕获的 $(C_{\mathrm{cap}},q_{\mathrm{cap}})$ 可能来自不同 epoch。故障按层级分类：高位错一组（误差 $\pm M$）与原周期错一拍（误差 $\pm1$）是不同故障。
derivation.en: The captured $(C_{\mathrm{cap}},q_{\mathrm{cap}})$ may come from different epochs. Faults are layered: a high count one group off (error $\pm M$) and a raw cycle off by one (error $\pm1$) are different faults.

derivation.zh: 组级误差在 $C$ 上修正，贡献 $M\kappa_C$；原周期级误差贡献 $\kappa_N$；residue 本身用重构值 $q_{\mathrm{corr}}$。按式 (1) 组合即得式 (10)。
derivation.en: Group errors are fixed on $C$, contributing $M\kappa_C$; raw-cycle errors contribute $\kappa_N$; the residue uses its reconstructed value $q_{\mathrm{corr}}$. Combining per Eq. (1) gives Eq. (10).

derivation.zh: 例（$M=8$，§6.1）：旧高位 + 新低位 $(10,0)$ 给出 80，相对新合法状态 88 错 −8，需 $\kappa_C=+1$；新高位 + 旧低位 $(11,7)$ 给出 95，相对旧合法状态 87 错 +8，需 $\kappa_C=-1$。
derivation.en: Example ($M=8$, §6.1): old high + new low $(10,0)$ gives 80, −8 off the new legal 88, needing $\kappa_C=+1$; new high + old low $(11,7)$ gives 95, +8 off the old legal 87, needing $\kappa_C=-1$.

derivation.zh: 校正范围是由时序上界导出的规范，不是预先任意选的编码宽度。
derivation.en: The correction range is a specification derived from timing bounds, not an arbitrarily pre-chosen code width.

pitfalls.zh: 不要用同一个无单位 kappa 混合三种职责；“统一采用 κ = −1/0/+1”已被修订；相对另一侧合法锚点比较时差值也可能表现为 ±7，必须先指定应关联的旧/新 epoch。
pitfalls.en: Never mix three roles in one unit-less kappa; "always use κ = −1/0/+1" has been revised; compared with the other legal anchor the difference may look like ±7, so the intended old/new epoch must be specified first.

title.zh: 低位盲区：整组误差不改变 q 与奇偶
title.en: Low-bit blind spot: a whole-group error keeps q and parity

meaning.zh: 误差恰为一整组 $M$ 时，既不改变 $q=N\bmod M$，也不改变原周期奇偶 $N\bmod 2$；只看低位或 raw parity 的检查看不出高位错组。
meaning.en: An error of exactly one group $M$ changes neither $q=N\bmod M$ nor the raw-cycle parity $N\bmod 2$; checks that only look at the low bits or raw parity cannot see a high-bit group error.

vars.zh: 原周期编号
分组倍率（4 或 8，均为偶数）

assumptions.en: $M=4$ or 8 (even).

derivation.zh: 整组误差即 $N\to N+M$。加上 $M$ 的整数倍不改变模 $M$ 余数：
derivation.en: A whole-group error is $N\to N+M$. Adding a multiple of $M$ leaves the residue mod $M$ unchanged:

derivation.zh: $M=4$ 或 8 是偶数，$M=2\cdot(M/2)$，所以加 $M$ 也不改变模 2 余数，即式 (11)。
derivation.en: $M=4$ or 8 is even, $M=2\cdot(M/2)$, so adding $M$ also leaves the residue mod 2 unchanged — Eq. (11).

derivation.zh: 因此只用 $q$ 或 raw parity 的 XOR（如直接搬用 Havens/Sony 的某个 low-bit XOR）可能完全看不出高位错组。
derivation.en: Hence an XOR using only $q$ or raw parity (e.g. a low-bit XOR transplanted from Havens/Sony) may miss a high-bit group error entirely.

derivation.zh: 需要能跨组翻转的冗余状态：高位最低位的独立观测、wrap toggle/sequence，或保证高位取自确定候选 epoch 的捕获协议。即便使用高位 parity，也只能在错误已被限定到相邻组时区分——相差两组会再次别名：
derivation.en: Redundant state that toggles across groups is needed: an independent observation of the high LSB, a wrap toggle/sequence, or a capture protocol that takes the high count from a definite candidate epoch. Even high-bit parity only works once errors are limited to adjacent groups — two groups alias again:

pitfalls.zh: 这是冗余码覆盖范围问题：先列出错误集合，再选冗余信息；L03 的 512 个案例确认 $+M$ 不改变 residue 和 raw parity。
pitfalls.en: This is a question of redundant-code coverage: list the error set first, then choose the redundant information; the 512 cases of L03 confirm that $+M$ changes neither residue nor raw parity.

title.zh: 锚点等价：J − μ = (J+1) − (μ+1)
title.en: Anchor equivalence: J − μ = (J+1) − (μ+1)

meaning.zh: 参考靠近相邻边沿 $J$ 与 $J+1$ 时，两种锚点表示同一相位；合格的交接只要求整数锚点与 fine 间隔共同变换。
meaning.en: When the reference is near adjacent edges $J$ and $J+1$, both anchors represent the same phase; a correct hand-off only requires the integer anchor and the fine interval to transform together.

vars.zh: 相邻两条边沿中较早的一条的编号
vars.en: index of the earlier of two adjacent edges

vars.zh: 相对边沿 $J$ 的相位间隔

assumptions.zh: 精确相位域等式；用单个平均周期把长时间间隔归一化时，还要满足 §3.3 / 式 (6) 的近似条件。
assumptions.en: An exact phase-domain identity; normalising a long interval with one average period additionally needs the approximation conditions of §3.3 / Eq. (6).

derivation.zh: 代数恒等式：
derivation.en: Algebraic identity:

derivation.zh: 物理含义：若改选 $J+1$ 作锚点，则到该边沿的间隔也必须多 1 个原周期（$\mu+1$），即 fine 必须相对 $J+1$ 而非 $J$。
derivation.en: Physical meaning: if $J+1$ is chosen as anchor, the interval to that edge must also be one raw cycle longer ($\mu+1$), i.e. fine must refer to $J+1$, not $J$.

derivation.zh: 因此合格的 coarse/fine 交接不一定需要每次都选择预先认定的唯一边沿；只要求锚点与 fine 间隔共同变换（不变量 I6）。
derivation.en: So a correct coarse/fine hand-off need not always pick one predetermined edge; it requires anchor and fine interval to transform together (invariant I6).

derivation.zh: 失败模式：整数取 $J+1$、fine 却仍相对 $J$，结果为 $(J+1)-\mu$，比正确值多出一整周期。
derivation.en: Failure mode: integer takes $J+1$ while fine still refers to $J$, giving $(J+1)-\mu$ — one whole cycle off.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把代数一致性误当作任意时域模型都精确；L05 的 256 个案例只验证相位域恒等式，时间归一化必须匹配。
pitfalls.en: Algebraic consistency is not exactness in every time-domain model; the 256 cases of L05 only verify the phase-domain identity — time normalisation must match.

title.zh: 匹配采样的建立约束
title.en: Setup constraint of matched sampling

meaning.zh: 第 $i$ 组的最早采样时刻必须不早于“目标逻辑边沿 + 该组最大传播延迟 + 建立时间”。
meaning.en: The earliest sampling instant of group $i$ must not precede "target logical edge + that group's maximum propagation delay + setup time".

vars.zh: 第 i 组最早采样时刻
vars.en: earliest sampling time of group i

vars.zh: 目标逻辑边沿时刻
vars.en: time of the target logical edge

vars.zh: 第 i 组最大传播延迟
vars.en: maximum propagation delay of group i

vars.zh: 第 i 组采样器建立时间
vars.en: setup time of group i sampler

assumptions.zh: 第 $i$ 组数据对应目标逻辑边沿 $t_E$，传播延迟落在 $[d_i^{min},d_i^{max}]$；所有组须针对同一个目标逻辑 epoch。
assumptions.en: Group $i$ data follow the target logical edge $t_E$ with propagation delay in $[d_i^{min},d_i^{max}]$; all groups must target the same logical epoch.

derivation.zh: 第 $i$ 组数据最晚在 $t_E+d_i^{max}$ 才稳定为新值。
derivation.en: Group $i$ data settle to the new value at the latest at $t_E+d_i^{max}$.

derivation.zh: 触发器要求数据在采样前至少保持稳定 $t_{su,i}$，故采样时刻 $\ge t_E+d_i^{max}+t_{su,i}$。
derivation.en: The flip-flop needs the data stable for $t_{su,i}$ before sampling, so the sampling instant must be $\ge t_E+d_i^{max}+t_{su,i}$.

derivation.zh: 取最坏组合（采样最早 $t_{S,i}^{min}$、传播最慢 $d_i^{max}$）即得式 (13)。
derivation.en: Taking the worst combination (earliest sample $t_{S,i}^{min}$, slowest propagation $d_i^{max}$) gives Eq. (13).

pitfalls.zh: 把任意组都“等到稳定再采”并不能保证采到同一拍；延迟链不能当作理想常数，min/max 必须覆盖 PVT。
pitfalls.en: Simply "waiting until stable" for each group does not guarantee they capture the same step; delay chains are not ideal constants and min/max must cover PVT.

title.zh: 匹配采样的保持约束
title.en: Hold constraint of matched sampling

meaning.zh: 第 $i$ 组的最晚采样时刻加保持时间，必须不晚于该组下一次可能改写的最早时刻。
meaning.en: The latest sampling instant of group $i$ plus hold time must not be later than the earliest moment that group can next be overwritten.

vars.zh: 第 i 组最晚采样时刻
vars.en: latest sampling time of group i

vars.zh: 保持时间
该组下一次可能改写的逻辑事件
vars.en: next logical event that may overwrite the group

vars.zh: 该事件的最小传播延迟
vars.en: minimum propagation delay of that event

assumptions.zh: $t_{next,i}$ 未必每组都等于 $t_E+T_0$（例如高位组只在组边界改写）。
assumptions.en: $t_{next,i}$ is not necessarily $t_E+T_0$ for every group (e.g. the high group only changes at group boundaries).

derivation.zh: 该组下一次改写最早在 $t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}$ 到达采样器。
derivation.en: The next overwrite of the group reaches the sampler at the earliest at $t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}$.

derivation.zh: 采样后数据还需保持 $t_{h,i}$，因此最晚采样时刻 + 保持时间不得超过该时刻。
derivation.en: After sampling the data must still hold for $t_{h,i}$, so latest sample + hold must not exceed that moment.

derivation.zh: 取最坏组合（采样最晚、下一变化最早）即得式 (14)。
derivation.en: Taking the worst combination (latest sample, earliest next change) gives Eq. (14).

pitfalls.zh: 只检查建立约束而忽略保持约束，可能采到下一拍；更重要的是所有组都要针对同一个目标逻辑 epoch。
pitfalls.en: Checking only setup and ignoring hold may capture the next step; above all, every group must target the same logical epoch.

title.zh: 每组建立/保持余量 m_i、h_i
title.en: Per-group setup/hold margins m_i, h_i

meaning.zh: 把式 (13)–(14) 写成余量形式：$m_i>0$ 且 $h_i>0$ 对每组成立，且所有组属于同一 epoch，才算通过验收。
meaning.en: Eqs. (13)–(14) written as margins: acceptance requires $m_i>0$ and $h_i>0$ for every group, with all groups in the same epoch.

vars.zh: 第 i 组建立余量
第 i 组保持余量

assumptions.zh: 应根据实际电路的 min/max 表计算，而不是在未选工艺/负载前填写一个貌似确定的 ps 数值。
assumptions.en: To be computed from the real circuit's min/max tables, not filled with a seemingly definite ps number before process/load are chosen.

derivation.zh: 式 (13) 移项：$t_{S,i}^{min}-t_E-d_i^{max}-t_{su,i}\ge0$，定义左边为 $m_i$。
derivation.en: Rearrange Eq. (13): $t_{S,i}^{min}-t_E-d_i^{max}-t_{su,i}\ge0$; call the left side $m_i$.

derivation.zh: 式 (14) 移项：$t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}-t_{S,i}^{max}-t_{h,i}\ge0$，定义左边为 $h_i$。
derivation.en: Rearrange Eq. (14): $t_{next,i}+d_{next,i}^{min}-t_{S,i}^{max}-t_{h,i}\ge0$; call the left side $h_i$.

derivation.zh: 验收：每组 $m_i>0,h_i>0$，且所有组属于同一 epoch。Zong Fig.9 的理想匹配提供约半个 CKV 周期的相对读出位置；移植时应按实际电路计算余量。
derivation.en: Acceptance: $m_i>0,h_i>0$ for every group and one common epoch. The ideal matching of Zong Fig. 9 gives a relative read-out position of about half a CKV period; when porting, compute the margins for the real circuit.

pitfalls.zh: 最终统一输出不自动证明中间每一级的 setup/hold 满足；本报告没有给出虚构的最差 PVT margin。
pitfalls.en: A final common output does not by itself prove setup/hold at every stage; the report gives no invented worst-case PVT margin.

title.zh: 目标边沿编号分解 J_plan = M·H_J + s_J
title.en: Target edge index J_plan = M·H_J + s_J

meaning.zh: 执行链把计划的目标边沿编号按式 (1) 同样的方式分解：高位 $H_J$ 交给慢速域匹配与计划，slot $s_J$ 交给高速少量状态执行。
meaning.en: The execution chain decomposes the planned edge index the same way as Eq. (1): the high part $H_J$ goes to the slow domain for matching and planning, the slot $s_J$ to a small fast state for execution.

vars.zh: 计划的目标边沿编号（原周期）
高位部分（组）
组内 slot，$0\ldots M-1$

assumptions.zh: P/S 的系统语义是“执行指定边沿”；持续 CNT 仍独立记录实际经过的 $CK_0$ 周期。
assumptions.en: The system meaning of P/S is "execute a designated edge"; the persistent CNT still independently records the $CK_0$ cycles that actually pass.

derivation.zh: 与式 (1) 相同的带余除法：
derivation.en: Same division with remainder as Eq. (1):

derivation.zh: 慢速域处理高位匹配（当高位计数到达 $H_J$）、未来计划和并行控制。
derivation.en: The slow domain handles high-part matching (when the high count reaches $H_J$), future planning and parallel control.

derivation.zh: 高速少量状态负责 slot / phase-local enable、脉冲形成及根时钟重定时，在第 $s_J$ 个原周期放出边沿。
derivation.en: A small fast state handles slot / phase-local enable, pulse forming and root-clock retiming, releasing the edge in raw cycle $s_J$.

derivation.zh: 实际执行了哪条边沿要由独立的执行回执给出 $J_{\mathrm{observed}}$，不能由 $J_{\mathrm{plan}}$ 自证（不变量 I4）。
derivation.en: Which edge was actually executed must come from an independent execution receipt, $J_{\mathrm{observed}}$, not self-certified by $J_{\mathrm{plan}}$ (invariant I4).

pitfalls.zh: 不能把计划字延迟若干拍后改名为 $J_{\mathrm{exec}}$；错沿、丢沿、重复沿和 gate control 晚到可能完全不改变数字计划。
pitfalls.en: Do not rename the plan word delayed by a few clocks as $J_{\mathrm{exec}}$; wrong, lost or duplicate edges and late gate control may leave the digital plan completely unchanged.

title.zh: 选沿 deadline
title.en: Edge-selection deadline

meaning.zh: 选择命令到达执行器的时刻，加上执行建立时间和保护时间，必须不晚于目标边沿。
meaning.en: The arrival time of the selection command at the executor, plus execution setup and guard time, must not be later than the target edge.

vars.zh: 命令到达执行器的时刻
vars.en: time the command reaches the executor

vars.zh: 选择控制需在目标边沿前建立的时间
vars.en: time the selection control must be set up before the target edge

vars.zh: 保护时间
目标边沿时刻

assumptions.zh: 目标边沿是未来可执行的边沿；REF 之后的 snapshot、CDC、decode 与低速计算都会消耗时间。
assumptions.en: The target edge is a future, executable edge; snapshot, CDC, decode and slow computation after REF all consume time.

derivation.zh: 选择控制必须在目标边沿前 $t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}$ 建立，再留出 $t_{\mathrm{guard}}$ 余量。
derivation.en: Selection control must be established $t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}$ before the target edge, plus a guard $t_{\mathrm{guard}}$.

derivation.zh: 命令在 $t_{\mathrm{arrive}}$ 到达，故需 $t_{\mathrm{arrive}}+t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}+t_{\mathrm{guard}}\le t_{\mathrm{target}}$。
derivation.en: The command arrives at $t_{\mathrm{arrive}}$, so $t_{\mathrm{arrive}}+t_{\mathrm{setup,exec}}+t_{\mathrm{guard}}\le t_{\mathrm{target}}$ is required.

derivation.zh: 因果性推论（§8.3）：若 $t_{\mathrm{target}}$ 已经过去，再正确的 $q$ 也无法倒退时间把那条边沿送入 TDC。可闭合的路径只有：事先预测并在目标前提交；高速前端并行捕获后慢速解码；或选用未来可执行边沿并接受其量程代价。
derivation.en: Causality corollary (§8.3): if $t_{\mathrm{target}}$ has already passed, even a correct $q$ cannot send that edge to the TDC back in time. The only closures: predict and commit before the target; capture candidates in parallel at the fast front-end and decode slowly; or select a future executable edge and accept the range cost.

derivation.zh: 不满足时：显式 LATE/MISS、重新规划一个不同的 $J$，或切换测量策略；任何补发都应改变执行回执及相位坐标（不变量 I7）。
derivation.en: If violated: explicit LATE/MISS, re-plan a different $J$, or switch the measurement strategy; any re-issue must change the execution receipt and phase coordinate (invariant I7).

pitfalls.zh: 不能悄悄在下一 slot 补发并仍返回原 edge ID；相邻事件还要保证连续两个合法 pulse 不合并、不丢失、不重复——通用 PISO 输出连续“1”的电平行为不一定等于两个独立采样边沿。
pitfalls.en: Never silently re-issue in the next slot and still return the old edge ID; for adjacent events two legal pulses must not merge, vanish or duplicate — a generic PISO outputting consecutive "1"s is not necessarily two independent sampling edges.

title.zh: 扣除路径延迟恢复原事件间隔
title.en: Removing path delays to recover the event interval

meaning.zh: 原事件间隔 = TDC 引脚时间差 − （边沿路径延迟 − 参考路径延迟）。DTC 按所在路径计入 $\tau_R$ 或 $\tau_E$。
meaning.en: Original event interval = TDC pin time difference − (edge-path delay − reference-path delay). A DTC counts in $\tau_R$ or $\tau_E$ according to the path it sits in.

vars.zh: TDC 引脚处测得的时间差
vars.en: time difference measured at the TDC pins

vars.zh: 边沿/参考路径延迟估计
恢复出的原事件间隔 $t_E-t_R$

assumptions.zh: 路径延迟需估计并携带校准版本（path_epoch）；同一 DTC 只能在一处计入。
assumptions.en: Path delays must be estimated with a calibration version (path_epoch); a DTC is counted in exactly one place.

derivation.zh: TDC 引脚实际时间差：
derivation.en: Actual time difference at the TDC pins:

derivation.zh: 整理为事件间隔加延迟差：
derivation.en: Rewrite as event interval plus delay difference:

derivation.zh: 解出 $\Delta t$ 并用估计值代入，即得式 (18)。
derivation.en: Solve for $\Delta t$ and substitute estimates to obtain Eq. (18).

derivation.zh: DTC 插在参考路径时其延迟计入 $\tau_R$；插在反馈路径时计入 $\tau_E$。全书统一使用这一路径定义。
derivation.en: A DTC in the reference path adds to $\tau_R$; in the feedback path it adds to $\tau_E$. The whole design uses this one path definition.

pitfalls.zh: 不能一处把 DTC 当已补偿、另一处再次添加；符号写反会把 DTC 延迟加倍而不是抵消。
pitfalls.en: Never treat the DTC as compensated in one place and add it again in another; a sign slip doubles the DTC delay instead of cancelling it.

title.zh: TDC 码归一化到原周期
title.en: Normalising the TDC code to raw cycles

meaning.zh: 把 TDC 码减零点、乘时间 LSB、除以周期估计，再加剩余校准相位偏置，得到以原周期计的 $\widehat\mu$。
meaning.en: Subtract the zero code, multiply by the time LSB, divide by the period estimate and add the residual calibration offset to get $\widehat\mu$ in raw cycles.

vars.zh: TDC 输出码与零点码
vars.en: TDC output code and zero code

vars.zh: 时间 LSB（s/码）
原周期估计（s）
剩余的校准相位偏置（原周期）

assumptions.zh: 局部频率近似恒定（同式 6）；`LSB_t`、`code_0`、选相/DCC 偏差、差分路径延迟和周期估计携带相容的校准版本。
assumptions.en: Locally constant frequency (as in Eq. 6); `LSB_t`, `code_0`, phase-selection/DCC offsets, differential path delays and the period estimate carry compatible calibration versions.

derivation.zh: 去零点：$\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0$ 是相对零时间差的码差。
derivation.en: Remove the zero point: $\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0$ is the code difference relative to zero time difference.

derivation.zh: 乘时间 LSB 得时间：$(\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0)\,\mathrm{LSB}_t\approx\widehat{\Delta t}$（路径延迟已按式 18 处理）。
derivation.en: Multiply by the time LSB to get time: $(\mathrm{code}-\mathrm{code}_0)\,\mathrm{LSB}_t\approx\widehat{\Delta t}$ (path delays handled per Eq. 18).

derivation.zh: 除以周期估计换到原周期（式 6），再加剩余偏置：
derivation.en: Divide by the period estimate to convert to raw cycles (Eq. 6), then add the residual offset:

pitfalls.zh: 将 raw code 直接当作原周期小数，可能把增益或时钟节点差错隐藏在相位环路中；fine 与 coarse 权重必须使用相容的校准（tdc_gain_epoch、period_epoch、path_epoch）。
pitfalls.en: Using the raw code directly as a raw-cycle fraction can hide gain or clock-node errors inside the phase loop; fine and coarse weights must use compatible calibration (tdc_gain_epoch, period_epoch, path_epoch).

title.zh: Fine 采用条件 F_usable
title.en: Fine-usable condition F_usable

meaning.zh: 只有码合法、量程内、锚点一致、epoch 一致且校准相容五项同时成立，fine 才可用于精确相位。
meaning.en: Fine may be used for an exact phase only when the code is legal, in range, anchor-consistent, epoch-consistent and calibration-compatible — all five at once.

vars.zh: 码合法
量程内（来自可实现的 saturate/overflow/窗口检查）
实际所选物理边沿与其编号一致
vars.en: actually selected edge matches its index

vars.zh: 与 coarse 属于同一 epoch
校准版本相容

assumptions.zh: 每个 V 都必须由电路可获得的信息给出，而不是由仿真器中不可见的理想相位给出。
assumptions.en: Every V must come from information the circuit can actually obtain, not from an ideal phase only visible in a simulator.

derivation.zh: 这是一条规范（逻辑与），不是推导结果：任一判据失败都意味着 fine 码不能当作精确残差。
derivation.en: This is a specification (logical AND), not a derived result: any failed predicate means the fine code is not an exact residual.

derivation.zh: $V_{\mathrm{range}}$ 必须来自电路可实现的 saturate/overflow/窗口检查；$V_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ 要求实际所选物理边沿与其编号一致（回执，I4）。
derivation.en: $V_{\mathrm{range}}$ must come from circuit-realisable saturate/overflow/window checks; $V_{\mathrm{anchor}}$ requires the actually selected physical edge to match its index (receipt, I4).

derivation.zh: $F_{\mathrm{usable}}=1$ → 输出 FINE（anchor − μ）；否则降级为 COARSE（带误差上界）或 INVALID（不变量 I5、§10.3 伪代码）。
derivation.en: $F_{\mathrm{usable}}=1$ → output FINE (anchor − μ); otherwise degrade to COARSE (with an error bound) or INVALID (invariant I5, §10.3 pseudo-code).

derivation.zh: 一侧饱和可能仍保留“误差方向”信息，可参与单独定义的限幅控制策略（如 Zong 的瞬态处理），但不能标记为精确的 fine residual。
derivation.en: One-sided saturation may keep "error direction" information usable by a separately defined clamp strategy (like Zong's transient handling), but must not be labelled an exact fine residual.

pitfalls.zh: 饱和码不能作为精确 fine：$Q(1.5R)=Q(3R)=R$，事后减整周期也无法恢复（L06）。
pitfalls.en: A saturated code is never exact fine: $Q(1.5R)=Q(3R)=R$, and subtracting whole cycles afterwards cannot recover it (L06).

title.zh: 粗相位误差 e_c = R − N_R
title.en: Coarse phase error e_c = R − N_R

meaning.zh: 参考累加相位与 coarse 整数观测之差，是量化较粗的相位误差；fine 无效而 coarse 可靠时可据此接管。
meaning.en: The difference between the accumulated reference phase and the coarse integer observation — a coarsely quantised phase error that can take over when fine is invalid but coarse is reliable.

vars.zh: 第 k 个参考事件的参考累加相位
vars.en: accumulated reference phase at reference event k

vars.zh: 同一事件的 coarse 整数相位观测
vars.en: coarse integer phase observation of the same event

vars.zh: 粗相位误差（原周期）

assumptions.zh: coarse 观测可靠（快照相干、epoch 正确）；量化误差需给出上界。
assumptions.en: The coarse observation is reliable (coherent snapshot, correct epoch); the quantisation error needs a stated bound.

derivation.zh: 参考侧期望的相位为 $R[k]$；振荡器侧实际计到的整数相位为 $N_R[k]$。二者之差定义为粗相位误差：
derivation.en: The reference side expects phase $R[k]$; the oscillator side has actually counted integer phase $N_R[k]$. Their difference defines the coarse phase error:

derivation.zh: 它是相位误差，只是缺少 fine 残差而量化较粗；使用时应携带量化误差上界，或只把符号/区间信息送入受控策略。
derivation.en: It is a phase error, just coarsely quantised for lack of the fine residual; use it with a quantisation bound, or feed only sign/interval information to a controlled strategy.

derivation.zh: 若 coarse 也无法判定，本次观测必须 INVALID，而不是强行拼接。
derivation.en: If coarse cannot decide either, the observation must be INVALID rather than force-stitched.

pitfalls.zh: coarse 接管不等于删除 fine，更不等于凭空加一个 FLL；fine 恢复时还要检查坐标偏置一致与控制状态连续，避免 phase_source 切换引入整周期跳变。
pitfalls.en: Coarse takeover neither deletes fine nor magically adds an FLL; when fine recovers, check coordinate-offset consistency and control-state continuity so switching phase_source does not cause a whole-cycle jump.

title.zh: e_c 的差分 = 频率误差的量化观测
title.en: Difference of e_c = quantised frequency-error observation

meaning.zh: 粗相位误差的一阶差分等于本参考周期期望的原周期数 FCW 与实测周期数之差，才对应频率误差。
meaning.en: The first difference of the coarse phase error equals the expected raw cycles per reference period (FCW) minus the counted cycles — only this corresponds to a frequency error.

vars.zh: 第 k 个参考周期的频率控制字（期望原周期数）
vars.en: frequency control word of reference period k (expected raw cycles)

vars.zh: 该参考周期内实测的原周期数
vars.en: raw cycles counted during that reference period

assumptions.zh: 参考累加相位逐参考周期累加 FCW：$R[k]-R[k-1]=FCW[k]$。
assumptions.en: The reference phase accumulates FCW once per reference period: $R[k]-R[k-1]=FCW[k]$.

derivation.zh: 对式 (21) 取相邻两次之差：
derivation.en: Take the difference of Eq. (21) at two consecutive events:

derivation.zh: 参考累加相位每个参考周期增加 FCW，即 $R[k]-R[k-1]=FCW[k]$，代入即得式 (22)。
derivation.en: The reference accumulator adds FCW per period, $R[k]-R[k-1]=FCW[k]$; substituting gives Eq. (22).

derivation.zh: 右边是“期望周期数 − 实测周期数”，即频率误差的量化观测；而 $e_c$ 本身是相位误差。
derivation.en: The right side is "expected cycles − counted cycles", a quantised observation of frequency error, whereas $e_c$ itself is a phase error.

derivation.zh: 所以 CNT 不天然意味着一条独立 FLL；只有另行设计频率误差控制器、状态机或增益路径时，才应称为 FLL-assisted 控制。
derivation.en: So a CNT does not by itself imply an independent FLL; only with a separately designed frequency-error controller, state machine or gain path should it be called FLL-assisted control.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把 $e_c$ 直接当频率误差送入积分；冻结积分、限幅积分或分阶段重新准入都需要闭环验证，本文不预设已经优选完成。
pitfalls.en: Do not feed $e_c$ to an integrator as if it were a frequency error; frozen, clamped or staged re-admission of the integrator all need closed-loop verification, and none is presumed optimal here.
